operating_rules: CURRENT contains at most one actively implemented product train and may be represented as a stacked frontier when dependent PRs are already in flight.
NEXT is ordered and contains concrete player-facing trains, not cleanup placeholders.
Canonical Zork solutions remain valid even when new physically valid workarounds are added.
A reusable object or learned workaround remains useful wherever the same physical logic reasonably applies.
Cleverness should reduce repeated friction rather than create a new fetch-grind tax.
Soft sequence breaks are allowed only when physically earned, state-safe, and non-bricking.
Mara remains one authored human adventurer: no approval meter, generic follower framework, skill tree, omniscient companion AI, or romance meter.
Mara becoming a genuine love interest is an explicit future product direction; romance must be earned through lived history and mutual choice rather than bolted on as a score system.
No universal crafting grid, arbitrary object-pair matrix, generic physics simulator, recursive audit machinery, TODO-only slice, or no-op scaffolding.
DONE requires merged or otherwise immutable proof.

current.title: Mara Causal Biography & Shared Danger
current.outcome: Give Mara named lived facts and causal decisions rooted in shared danger rather than a global relationship score.

current.title: Mara Field Capability Discovery
current.outcome: Build capability biography through authored recovery, discovery, and reuse rather than a skill tree.

current.title: Mara Lived Feeling, Rupture & Repair
current.outcome: Let lived events produce appraisal, carried meaning, current feeling, changed choice, rupture, boundaries, and earned repair without an emotion or love meter.

current.title: Mara Anticipation, Worry & Protective Initiative
current.outcome: Turn specific lived danger history into prospective concern and protective initiative before another injury while preserving rupture boundaries.

next.title: Hostile Rooms & Reactive Threats
next.outcome: Build authored dangerous locations where a live threat observes and reacts to what the Adventurer actually does; interaction costs opportunity because the threat is physically present.
boundaries: dragon/fire must compose with existing fire-smoke-material authority
multiple credible approaches and retreat remain possible

next.title: Ablative Protection & Equipment Consequence
next.outcome: Let authored protective objects physically carry the consequences they absorbed through charring, denting, soaking, abrasion, warping, cracking, or similar state.
boundaries: condition communicated through description and behavior
degradation only where it creates meaningful play

next.title: Perilous Affordances / Let the Player Be Wrong
next.outcome: Allow physically possible bad choices instead of meta-game refusals, with fair consequences, substitutes, recoverable failures, alternate routes, or honestly warned irreversible mistakes.

next.title: Consumable Light & Graduated Darkness
next.outcome: Make illumination authored world state with bright, weak, ember, and darkness conditions, flame transfer, wet/damaged fuel, and composition with fire, smoke, and grue ecology.

next.title: Learned Magic as Parser Capability
next.outcome: Let in-world learning of original Zork-native words, rites, formulae, signs, or commands expand what the parser meaningfully allows the Adventurer to do.

next.title: Semantic Examination & Hidden Structure
next.outcome: Make selected meaningful details in prose trustworthy parser targets so observation can reveal hidden structure through language rather than hotspot hunting.
boundaries: descriptions must honor selected interactive details

next.title: Clue Chains & Knowledge-Gated Interpretation
next.outcome: Carry learned meaning across locations so earlier documents, symbols, observations, museum evidence, and testimony can change later interpretation without requiring the original clue object.
boundaries: prefer named causal facts over generic clue counters
knowledge can substitute for carrying clue objects where realistic
companions do not become automatic hint engines

next.title: Structural Difficulty Modes
next.outcome: Change puzzle/world structure, evidence redundancy, recoverability, resource availability, and consequence windows rather than merely multiplying damage.
boundaries: no enemy-health multiplier masquerading as puzzle difficulty

next.title: Causal Death & Failure Feedback
next.outcome: Make death and near-death legibly communicate physical cause, ignored evidence, partially sound ideas, and the exact state/action that changed the outcome without giving away the solution.
boundaries: prefer richer near-death/persistent consequences where appropriate

next.title: Creature Encounters as Systemic Puzzles
next.outcome: Treat living beings as authored situations with distinct motives, senses, capacities, fears, possessions, territory, and memory rather than hit-point-shaped locks.
boundaries: troll thief grue dragon and Mara remain meaningfully different

next.title: Shadowgate-Style Macrostructure, Original Zork Region
next.outcome: Build a substantial original Zork region whose design grammar composes the prior Shadowgate-derived trains into one coherent adventure language.
next.target_shape: roughly 20-30 authored rooms if design earns that size
boundaries: prove integration rather than disconnected demos

future.title: Mara Earned Romance & Partnership
future.outcome: Make Mara a genuine love-interest and partnership path through mutual attraction, explicit mutual choice, closeness, boundaries, disagreement, initiative, repair, and lived history.
boundaries: planned real romance path, not brushed aside
prior rupture and repair remain true
not compulsory in histories that have not earned or mutually chosen it

future.title: Forest That Answers Back / Described World = Interactive World
future.outcome: Continue promoting selected concrete nouns in authored descriptions into targetable stateful world objects whose interactions compose with existing physicality.

future.title: Time, Weather & Disaster Arc
future.outcome: Layer authored time/weather conditions and selected disasters onto real geography and material state to create preparation, shelter, traversal, rescue, and aftermath play.

future.title: Museum & Ecology Second Expansion
future.outcome: Continue physical specimen provenance, collection, and ecology stories only where they create new field play rather than checklist accumulation.

future.title: Cross-IF / RPG Mechanics Adaptation — Later Inspirations
future.outcome: After the Shadowgate-first program, study other games for transferable design principles and rebuild selected concepts from scratch as original Zork-native systems.

future.title: Narrative Perspective Experiments
future.outcome: Build isolated first-person, third-person, and interactive-storybook editions against real canonical state without changing normal Zork.

future.title: DRAW + Multi-Agent Experiments
future.outcome: Explore DRAW and multi-agent interactive-fiction experiments only after the playable product supports them.

parked.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Glulx Game
parked.outcome: Remain a separate interactive-fiction product lane, never mixed into a Zork gameplay PR.

parked.title: Protected Corpus Acquisition
parked.outcome: Expand source evidence only through lawfully held local copies or verified rights.
